verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a multi-entity capability: entity-specific spend policies and controls in a single consolidated account, separate statement payments per business, one-step sync of transactions and reimbursements to multiple entities, and management of all global NetSuite entities in one multi-entity environment. The currency and consolidated-reporting parts of the story are weakly evidenced. The only currency claim covers employee reimbursements in 40 currencies, which says nothing about per-entity functional currencies. missing for 10: explicit multi-currency entity books (per-entity base currency, FX handling), documented consolidated cross-entity reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
